triggers.prompt: Clean up the branches that have already merged.
triggers.expected: Fires, and verifies each deletion against the forge rather than against git.

triggers.prompt: 清理一下仓库，收拾下没用的分支
Remove the worktrees I am no longer using.
triggers.expected: Fires, and keeps any worktree whose branch has no merged pull request.

triggers.prompt: 清掉已经合并过的分支
triggers.expected: Fires on a second Chinese phrasing rather than only on 清理一下.

non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Uncommitted work is not residue.

non_triggers.prompt: Reset this branch to origin and throw away my commits.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. It never discards a local commit.

non_triggers.prompt: Delete all untracked files in here.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire on untracked files the user has not been shown.

non_triggers.prompt: 把我没提交的改动都扔掉
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Discarding uncommitted work is destructive and outside this skill, in either language.
